title: Web Push notifications
summary: You can opt in to browser notifications for tickets, account alerts, announcements and rota notices, with quiet hours and an in-app bell. Lock-screen wording stays generic.

added: Notification preferences to choose browser push, email and the in-app bell per category, with quiet hours in UK time.
An in-app notification bell in the top bar, with an unread count and links to related pages.
Browser push for tickets, account and security alerts, announcements and rota or operations notices, when you have opted in and allowed notifications on the device.
A short guide on Notification preferences for iPhone and iPad (add the intranet to the Home Screen first).
An Admin Push delivery page with counts only, so admins can see delivery health without seeing message content.
changed: The local development site is documented and previewed over HTTPS, which browsers need for push.
security: Push payloads never include ticket subjects, replies, names or student or safeguarding detail.
Push starts off until you opt in; the browser only asks for permission after you press the button on Notification preferences.
accessibility: Notification preferences, the in-app bell and inbox, and the Admin Push delivery page are included in the accessibility check.

internal_notes: VAPID keys live only in the APES Vault and Cloudron shared env (private ops). Do not rotate casually. Queue worker must be running. Web Push DPIA is still a draft.
